mapper.sql: select a.id, a.phone, a.api_id, a.api_hash, a.tg_user_id, a.nickname, a.username, a.country, a.device_model, a.system_version, a.app_version, a.lang_code, a.system_lang_code, a.batch_no, a.status, a.proxy_ip_id, a.proxy_group_no, a.proxy_url, a.proxy_protocol, a.proxy_host, a.proxy_port, a.proxy_username, a.proxy_password, a.auto_reply, a.is_restricted, a.total_msg_count, a.sent_msg_count, a.recv_msg_count, a.node_id, a.json_content, a.last_login_time, a.create_time, a.update_time, b.title as batchTitle, pg.group_name as proxyGroupTitle from tg_telethon_account a left join tg_import_batch b on a.batch_no = b.batch_no left join tg_proxy_group pg on a.proxy_group_no = pg.group_no
mapper.select: select * from tg_telethon_account where (node_id IS NULL OR node_id = '') AND (is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL) order by id
mapper.update: update tg_telethon_account set node_id = #{nodeId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update tg_telethon_account set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}

#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tg_telethon_account (phone, batch_no, status, is_deleted, node_id, json_content, session_content, create_time) VALUES (#{phone}, #{batchNo}, 'waiting', 0, #{nodeId}, #{jsonContent}, #{sessionContent}, now()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE batch_no = #{batchNo}, status = 'waiting', is_deleted = 0, node_id = #{nodeId}, json_content = #{jsonContent}, session_content = #{sessionContent}, update_time = now()
mapper.update: update tg_telethon_account set proxy_ip_id = #{proxyIpId}, proxy_group_no = #{proxyGroupNo}, proxy_url = #{proxyUrl}, proxy_protocol = #{proxyProtocol}, proxy_host = #{proxyHost}, proxy_port = #{proxyPort}, proxy_username = #{proxyUsername}, proxy_password = #{proxyPassword}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update tg_telethon_account set auto_reply = #{autoReply}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update tg_telethon_account set auto_reply = #{autoReply}, update_time = now() where (is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL)
